blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Open sort menu traps keyboard focus: Tab is captured and Escape does nothing) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap (and 2.1.1 Keyboard). A keyboard user who opens "Sort: …" gets focus moved into the menu (line 12); pressing Tab (or Shift+Tab) is prevented and only cycles to the next item, and Escape has no handler, so the only way out is to pick an option — the user cannot leave the menu without changing the sort, nor reach the product list or the rest of the page. Per the APG menu button pattern, handle Escape (close the menu, return focus to the menu button without calling onChange) and stop intercepting Tab: let it close the menu and move focus on naturally. Also close the menu when focus leaves it, and add a test pressing Tab and Escape in the open menu.
findings.title: Open sort menu traps keyboard focus: Tab is captured and Escape does nothing

findings.evidence: <button ref={button} type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
findings.recommendation: WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value. aria-expanded is hard-coded to "false": after a screen reader user presses Enter on "Sort: Newest", the menu opens but the button still reports "collapsed", so the state change is misreported. Bind it to the state: aria-expanded={open}.
findings.title: Menu button always announces "collapsed", even when the menu is open
